sections.text:
-Target: all allies. Removes status ailments.
-Target: all allies. Healing Ability Power 80. Heals HP.
Healing Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Removes frenzy.
-Target: all allies. Permits piercing through damage reduction/reflection effects when attacking for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical and magic damage taken by 50% for 50 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Reduces ATK and MATK by 20% for 50 seconds [Demerit].
-Target: yourself. Applies blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) for 60 seconds.
-Applies Dazzle Collapse (Reduces attack Ability accuracy by 20%) to the enemy Field for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 8000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 8000
